title: EvaluateRequest
description: Core asks the engine to judge a driven experiment (POST /evaluate).

driver_channels.description: Driver-input metrics; a shift in them means the driver adapted to the setup.

parameter.description: Setup item the experiment changes; picks its margins from the engine's configuration.

look.description: Pre-registered look (ADR 0029): 0 before the first (fewer than 8 planned blocks), 1, 2 and 3 at 8, 10 and 12. Absent: counted from the passes' blocks.

extensions_left.description: How many more times the experiment may be extended. Absent: none.

offtrack.description: Push-lap passes per block and how many of them were off track (ADR 0029).

SuccessTest.title: SuccessTest
SuccessTest.description: The test an experiment must pass, fixed before driving.

channel.description: Metric id of the primary response.

rope.description: Half-width of the band of effects too small to matter, in the channel's unit.

GuardrailSpec.title: GuardrailSpec
GuardrailSpec.description: A channel that must not get worse by more than a tolerance.

tolerance.description: Allowed change in the bad direction, in the channel's unit.

PredictionSpec.title: PredictionSpec
PredictionSpec.description: What the hypothesis expects of one channel, written before driving.

low.description: Smallest expected size of the change.

high.description: Largest expected size of the change.

EvaluatePass.title: EvaluatePass
EvaluatePass.description: One corner pass of the experiment.

block.description: Order of the run block the pass was driven in.

lap.description: Lap within the session; passes of one lap share their errors.

metrics.description: Metric id to value; null when it could not be measured on this pass.

covariates.description: Conditions to adjust for: fuel_l, tyre_core_c, time_since_start_s (from the experiment's first push pass), ers_charge_start on a car with a hybrid battery, and session_<n> = 1 on the passes of the experiment's n-th game session (n >= 2), else 0.

ExcludedPasses.title: ExcludedPasses
ExcludedPasses.description: Passes core left out before the engine saw them (ADR 0029).

setup_mismatch.description: Driven on a setup that is not the block's arm.

source_mismatch.description: From a session whose driver is not the experiment's.

OfftrackBlock.title: OfftrackBlock
OfftrackBlock.description: One run block's push-lap passes on the arm's setup and its own driver.

passes.description: All of them, valid or not.

VehicleResponseInput.title: VehicleResponseInput
VehicleResponseInput.description: What the engine needs to measure the car's response per frozen phase and speed regime inside the verdict (ADR 0034): the track, where each session's raw samples are, and the experiment's push passes on the arm's setup from its driver, off-track ones included (valid false: never compared, but they may complete the previous pass's traction).

track_length_m.description: Lap length along the AI line.

item_role.description: The changed setup item's role in the catalog (arb, wing, bias, ...); picks the parameter row of the observables mapping.

item_axle.description: F or R when the changed item belongs to one axle; empty otherwise.

VehicleCorner.title: VehicleCorner
VehicleCorner.description: Where a corner and its zone are, in metres from the start line.

VehicleSession.title: VehicleSession
VehicleSession.description: Where one game session's raw samples are.

parquet_dir.description: Directory of the session's Parquet parts.

VehiclePass.title: VehiclePass
VehiclePass.description: One push-lap pass, with the block, lap code and covariates of its EvaluatePass.

seq.description: Order of the pass within its session.

t_start_s.description: When the pass started, seconds on any clock shared by the session's passes.
